M-FV-CORE.Purpose: The tooling core machinery (the core section of Scripts/_lib.py): the 0/1/2 exit-code vocabulary, typed configuration, typed domain models, content fingerprints, the task store, and the linear pipeline. Domain-free by contract.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Scripts/_lib.py (core section): errors (ExitCode, ToolingError hierarchy, die), config (REPO_ROOT, CacheLayout, Profile), models (RunSpec, GameInfo, ModPin, RunComposition, RunPlan, Verdict, DiffResult), hashing (file/tree/doc digests), TaskStore, Pipeline.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Domain knowledge (dotnet, game, runs) — owned by M-DOTNET / M-GAME / M-RUNS; the core never imports them.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Pipeline compositions — owned by M-OP-TEST / M-OP-PLAY.

Principles.PRIN-001: Data crosses task boundaries only as typed frozen models — never loose dicts; JSON exists only at the evidence boundary.
Principles.PRIN-002: Cached tasks resume, never skip blindly: a resumed body recomputes cheap outputs and skips expensive external side effects (best-effort acceleration, not a correctness guarantee).
Principles.PRIN-003: Infrastructure failures resolve to the harness-did-not-run code — never misread as data verdicts (P-FLEXVERSE-TOOLING.PRIN-002).
Principles.PRIN-004: The core is domain-free: adding a new operation or domain must never require core changes.

Requirements.REQ-001: All cache and staging paths resolve through CacheLayout (including docker build cache under .cache/buildx); no module hardcodes its own layout.
Requirements.REQ-002: Pipeline.run executes stages strictly in declaration order; out() fails loudly on a not-yet-run stage.
Requirements.REQ-003: A fingerprint-hit stage resumes (recomputes cheap outputs, skips expensive side effects); stages without a fingerprint always run.

M-FV-CORE.Codemap: * `Pipeline.run(name, body(cached), fingerprint)` -> `TaskStore.hit/record` ; `Pipeline.out(id)` => typed earlier output * linear by design: composition IS the call order — no dependency graph machinery * `CacheLayout` => `.cache/{game,mods,staging,runs,pkg,tasks,buildx}` + `nuget_env` + `docker_env` ; `tasks/` = fingerprints, `staging/` = run scratch * `ExitCode{0|1|2}` <= `die()` : only authorized exit path * `tree_digest(Source/ + props)` => build fingerprints ; `doc_digest(spec)` => stage_mods fingerprint
